subject.title: feat: trace Claude Code CLI model calls

question: Should Claude Code CLI diagnostic output capture include streamed `thinking` blocks under the existing opt-in `captureContent.outputMessages` policy?
rationale: Native model-call diagnostics already include reasoning under this opt-in policy, but extending that behavior to Claude CLI exports additional potentially sensitive debugging content to downstream telemetry and requires an explicit privacy-boundary decision.

options.title: Keep opt-in parity
options.body: Include Claude thinking under the existing disabled-by-default trusted capture policy and document that content explicitly alongside the telemetry migration notes.

options.title: Exclude CLI thinking
options.body: Capture visible text and tool identity only until a separate reasoning-specific capture control and migration contract are approved.

recommendation.title: Keep opt-in parity
recommendation.body: Include Claude thinking under the existing disabled-by-default trusted capture policy and document that content explicitly alongside the telemetry migration notes.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans the Claude CLI runtime, established diagnostic capture behavior, and user-facing privacy expectations rather than being a mechanical exporter repair.
